title: fix(app-shell): navigation edit mode keeps the 240 px rail and draws the remove control without hover (objectui#12519)
body:
Fixes #12519
Clause-②: no

## What changed

Measured first on main `9231820` (1280 px, HotCRM `objectstack dev --fresh`, a writable package with a six-entry app). Edit set the Interfaces rail to `w-72`, so the rail went from 240 to 288 px and the content column moved from x 240 to x 288. The edit rows were `AppNavCanvas` cards, not `AppNavInspector`'s. Each card showed the label, the kind chip and the api name as a code chip, and the chip crushed labels to 0 to 6 px. The trash was already in the tab order (objectui#11776) but drawn `w-0 opacity-0` until hover or focus, so the label moved when it appeared.

1. **The rail keeps 240 px.** `InterfacesPillar` no longer passes `width={editNav ? 'w-72' : undefined}`. Nothing else passed `StudioRail`'s `width` prop, so the prop retires: the rail is `STUDIO_RAIL_WIDTH` in every pillar and mode, and a per-mode width cannot come back through it.
2. **The row fits a 32 px line in 240 px.** `AppNavCanvas` cards are `h-8` and hold a 16 px grip, the label, the kind chip (tightened to `h-5 px-1.5`) and the remove control. The api name moves onto the card's `title` as `LABEL · TARGET`; an entry with no target shows just its label. The kind icon before the label is dropped: the card's target lists the row as handle, label, kind chip and trash, and the toned chip already names the kind. Measured after the change: the rows are 205 px wide (nested 189 px), 32 px tall, nothing overflows, and labels get 66 to 107 px.
3. **The remove control is always drawn.** A fixed `h-6 w-6 shrink-0` at `opacity-50`, full on the card's hover, the card's focus-visible or its own focus-visible. It stays in the tab order straight after its card, so showing it never moves the label.
4. **The content column does not move.** Measured: rail 240 px and content column x 240 out of edit mode and in edit mode, in light and in dark.

Also in `AppNavCanvas`, needed for the 240 px fit or by the epic rulings:
- Nested rows indent by class (`pl-4`, `pl-8`) instead of an inline `paddingLeft` style. Rulings: Tailwind utilities only, no inline style. HotCRM's deepest nesting is one level: `crm.app.ts` has six groups, each with leaf children.
- In a narrow rail, the canvas header's Add nav item button takes a line of its own (`flex-wrap`, `whitespace-nowrap`) instead of folding its words onto three lines. Where there is room it stays on one line, as before.

## Scoping: both mounts, no new prop

`AppNavCanvas` also renders in the metadata-admin app designer (`AppPreview`). The compact row applies there too, with no Studio-only prop.
- Business need: the only pull for the row's shape is the 240 px rail. The api name stays one hover away in the title, and the selected entry's inspector shows its target in both surfaces. The always-drawn, keyboard-reachable remove control is an accessibility fix with no reason to stay hover-only anywhere.
- Long-term soundness: one row, one look. A `compact` prop would fork the editor's row into two renderings to maintain.
- AI-error resistance: neutral. No metadata key moves; a host-only React prop is the kind of key an agent can mistake for a node key.
- Startup focus: no new prop surface; one prop (`StudioRail.width`) retires.

The app designer screenshot below shows the row there.

## Pins that moved, and why

These pins read what the row used to show; each keeps its subject and now reads the title:
- `AppPreview.test.tsx`: targets read from each card's title; the group child's url and the inherited `account` label.
- `AppPreview.docEntry-11197.test.tsx`: the doc page as label plus title.
- `StudioDesignSurface.navDraftLabels-11862.test.tsx`: the machine name on the title.
- `AppNavCanvas.navPayload-11776.test.tsx`: the remove control's classes; it is drawn now rather than collapsed.

On the evidence branch `claude/issue-12519-evidence`, never merged (screenshots do not enter main). The before state is the card's own evidence and the numbers above.

Stack: HotCRM `63db83e` with `objectstack dev --fresh`, behind this branch's vite console. The writable package `com.default.ticket-desk` was created in the UI; its app's navigation was seeded through the draft save.

## Test evidence (head `14a7dd4`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`: exit 0. Test Files 1398 passed and 1 skipped (1399); Tests 13382 passed and 9 skipped (13391).
- New pins:
  - `InterfacesPillar.editRailWidth-12519.test.tsx`: the rail's width class is the same in edit mode, out of it and after Done; the content column stays its next sibling; the remove button is there without hover and Tab reaches it.
  - `AppNavCanvas.compactRow-12519.test.tsx`: the row is 32 px with the api name on its title; the remove control is a fixed 24 px and dimmed, not hidden, and Tab reaches it; nested indent by class with no style attribute.
- Ablation, once each, through `ablation-replace.mjs` with a proven restore:
  - the `w-72` override back: the width pin went red;
  - the hidden trash classes back: 3 red;
  - the api code chip back in the row: 3 red;
  - the inline indent back: 1 red;
  - the title removed: 6 red.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0; `build` exit 0, with dist completeness at 1104 files.
- `eslint` on the touched files: 0 errors (the warnings are on untouched lines).
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`: exit 0. No i18n keys were added.

## Changeset

`.changeset/12519-nav-edit-rail.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`: patch).

## Acceptance notes

- What Add creates and the ten-kind picker (objectui#12455) are untouched; every existing `data-testid` and i18n key stays.
- The rail heading at 240 px still truncates (TICKET DESK · NAVIGA…) beside Edit and Done, in both modes, as it did before this change.
